class.name: AudioBusSettingsServer
class.brief_description: Settings server for the volume, mute and solo values that the player may change on the audio buses.

method.name: apply_preset
method.description: Sets the stored values ([member store_volume], [member store_mute], [member store_solo]) of the player buses that [param preset] lists, in one change of the list: applied at once in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_IMMEDIATE]. Buses that the preset does not list, values that are not stored and buses that are not player buses keep their values. The preset becomes the current preset, see [method get_current_preset]. Returns [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] if [param preset] is [code]null[/code].

method.name: get_bus_names
method.description: Returns the names of all buses that have an entry, in the order of the list: the player buses of the layout first, then stored player buses that the layout does not have.

method.name: get_bus_volume_db
method.description: Returns the pending volume of the bus [param bus] in decibels. If the volume is not stored ([member store_volume]), this is the value of the layout. For a bus of the layout without an entry, returns its value in [AudioServer]. Reports an error and returns [code]0.0[/code] if there is no such bus.

method.name: get_bus_volume_linear
method.description: Returns the pending volume of the bus [param bus] as a linear value: [code]1.0[/code] is 0 dB (100 %), [code]0.0[/code] is silence (-80 dB or lower). Useful for sliders in percent.

method.name: get_current_preset
method.description: Returns the preset of the last [method apply_preset] call while the pending values still match it (see [method matches_preset]); otherwise [code]null[/code]. The current preset is not saved: after a restart it is [code]null[/code] until a preset is applied again.

method.name: has_bus
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the bus [param bus] has an entry or exists in the current bus layout of [AudioServer].

method.name: is_bus_mute
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the bus [param bus] is muted in the pending settings. If the mute state is not stored ([member store_mute]), this is the value of the layout.

method.name: is_bus_solo
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the bus [param bus] is in solo mode in the pending settings. If the solo state is not stored ([member store_solo]), this is the value of the layout.

method.name: is_custom
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if no preset is current: no preset was applied, or a value was changed after [method apply_preset] and the values no longer match the preset. A menu shows "Custom" then.

method.name: is_player_bus
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the player controls the bus [param bus]: [member player_buses] is empty or contains it. Returns [code]false[/code] for an empty name.

method.name: matches_preset
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the pending values of the player buses that [param preset] lists are equal to the preset's values. Only stored values are compared; buses without an entry are skipped. Use it to find out which of several presets the current values match.

method.name: set_bus_mute
method.description: Mutes or unmutes the bus [param bus]. Prints a warning and does nothing if the mute state is not stored ([member store_mute]) or [param bus] is not a player bus. Reports an error if the bus has no entry and does not exist in the bus layout.

method.name: set_bus_solo
method.description: Sets the solo mode of the bus [param bus]. Prints a warning and does nothing if the solo state is not stored ([member store_solo], off by default) or [param bus] is not a player bus. Reports an error if the bus has no entry and does not exist in the bus layout.

method.name: set_bus_volume_db
method.description: Sets the volume of the bus [param bus] in decibels, clamped to -80 dB … 24 dB (the range of the bus slider in the editor). If the bus exists in the layout but has no entry yet (a layout set by the game), an entry with its layout values is added first. Prints a warning and does nothing if the volume is not stored ([member store_volume]) or [param bus] is not a player bus. Reports an error if the bus has no entry and does not exist in the bus layout.

method.name: set_bus_volume_linear
method.description: Sets the volume of the bus [param bus] as a linear value ([code]1.0[/code] is 0 dB, [code]0.5[/code] is about -6 dB, [code]0.0[/code] or less is -80 dB). The value is stored in decibels, see [method set_bus_volume_db].

members.member: The buses the player controls. If empty, all buses of the layout. Only these buses have entries and get the stored values; other buses keep the values of the layout. Initialized from [member ProjectSettings.settings/audio_bus/player_buses] when the server is created, so the startup uses the project setting. A change takes effect on the next load or apply.

If [code]true[/code], the mute state of the player buses is saved, loaded, applied, emitted with [signal bus_mute_changed] and settable with [method set_bus_mute]. Initialized from [member ProjectSettings.settings/audio_bus/store_mute] when the server is created. A change takes effect on the next load, save or apply.

If [code]true[/code], the solo state of the player buses is saved, loaded, applied, emitted with [signal bus_solo_changed] and settable with [method set_bus_solo]. Initialized from [member ProjectSettings.settings/audio_bus/store_solo] (off by default) when the server is created. A change takes effect on the next load, save or apply.

If [code]true[/code], the volume of the player buses is saved, loaded, applied, emitted with [signal bus_volume_changed] and settable with [method set_bus_volume_db]. Initialized from [member ProjectSettings.settings/audio_bus/store_volume] when the server is created. A change takes effect on the next load, save or apply.

signal.name: bus_layout_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the list of buses changed: after [AudioServer] got a new bus layout ([method AudioServer.set_bus_layout], [method AudioServer.add_bus], [method AudioServer.remove_bus], ...) and the stored values of the player buses were pushed to it again, or when applied settings name other buses than before (for example a loaded file from another game version). Use it to rebuild an audio options menu with one slider per bus ([method get_bus_names]).

signal.name: bus_mute_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the mute state of the player bus [param bus_name] reached [AudioServer]. It fires once per change that reached [AudioServer]: by [method SettingsServer.apply] (also at startup after the settings file is loaded, and after [method SettingsServer.reset_to_defaults] in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_IMMEDIATE]), [method SettingsServer.apply_with_confirmation] and [method SettingsServer.cancel_confirmation] (with the restored value). Not emitted for pending changes in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_MANUAL], for buses that the bus layout does not have, or if [member store_mute] is [code]false[/code].

signal.name: bus_solo_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the solo state of the player bus [param bus_name] reached [AudioServer]. It fires once per change that reached [AudioServer]: by [method SettingsServer.apply] (also at startup after the settings file is loaded, and after [method SettingsServer.reset_to_defaults] in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_IMMEDIATE]), [method SettingsServer.apply_with_confirmation] and [method SettingsServer.cancel_confirmation] (with the restored value). Not emitted for pending changes in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_MANUAL], for buses that the bus layout does not have, or if [member store_solo] is [code]false[/code] (the default).

signal.name: bus_volume_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the volume of the player bus [param bus_name] reached [AudioServer], in decibels. It fires once per change that reached [AudioServer]: by [method SettingsServer.apply] (also at startup after the settings file is loaded, and after [method SettingsServer.reset_to_defaults] in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_IMMEDIATE]), [method SettingsServer.apply_with_confirmation] and [method SettingsServer.cancel_confirmation] (with the restored value). Not emitted for pending changes in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_MANUAL], for buses that the bus layout does not have, or if [member store_volume] is [code]false[/code]. Use it to update a volume label or to play a short sound at the new volume, for example on the [code]"Master"[/code] bus.
